reason: My agency already handles Instagram and picks the creators, and I already have creators asking me for free food every week, so finding more is not my problem. I'm not going to get staff at several outlets learning a coupon-and-PIN routine for a beta app from a small team.
objection: Getting my counter staff in every outlet to actually redeem coupons properly during a rush, and whether a small beta team will still be around in six months.
would_change_my_mind: If my agency used it and showed me a month of real numbers, customers per creator from one of my own outlets, without me or my staff doing extra work.
